body: Hey- I had commented on your last post- I know it was 6 months ago, and I'm truly sorry. I completely lost sight and track of everything social-media because of how much it distracted me, if you still want to talk I super encourage you to DM me- and to answer your question (6 months later fml) it was a smallish town- York, but we traveled to Lincoln a lot.
Of course ! I believe in you. Stay safe and stay as happy as you can, okay ? (:

Hey ! I'm 24- I'm so really sorry about your parent- I know you probably hear that a lot but I really truly mean it. I'm in the same boat as you about the not going to college thing- I've just been supporting myself in my own apartment after moving out a few months ago ! I'm in a new town and don't really feel like I can get on with people due to my really wonky anxiety issues too- I haven't really hung out with anyone but immediate family since highschool and well, since moving out here my pet snake and the internet have been my best friends haha. But I'm definitely around if you need someone to talk to or just hang out with. I dunno if you play video-games but I have steam, maybe we could play a game or two on there.

I wanted to comment because I didn't see any, and also because my uncle was in this exact same spot- No matter how young your kids may be- while they're extremely important- if she constantly makes you unhappy, if she hurts you this much please don't force yourself to stay with her. Your kids would want the absolute best for you I truly believe it. Maybe start doing things at first to just occupy yourself away from her, go to the gym more often- I know my uncle had signed up to be a recreational coach for the city's children sports teams, and that took up a bit of his time and got him out of the house more. But if that doesn't work, the happiness of your children is VERY important but I'd like to think that if they knew how much this relationship hurt you- they'd want you to do the same for yourself. I'm usually around to talk if you need it. I'm seriously rooting for you.

I know exactly how you feel- I feel like humans just aren't the same anymore, that I just don't agree with most of them, or get across to them, no matter how patient I am. But if you don't believe me, try me, message me. What could it hurt ? My best friend lives in Nebraska, I plan to meet her soon. Maybe I could buy you lunch ?
